name: lowcoding-airtable
description: Move a small company off Airtable onto its own CRM (Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, GitHub), planned from what is in the base.

plugins.name: airtable-exit
plugins.description: One setup command: connects Airtable read-only, reads the base, shows one plan to approve, then builds, deploys and migrates your own CRM on free plans.
